provenance: synthetic (hand-written, modelled on the Stratus CART_ADDR example; not recorded from a cluster)

fault.description: The cart service is missing the CART_ADDR environment variable, so it can't reach redis-cart and returns errors.

stage1_expected.description: Signals Stage 1 (F1) must flag with the default thresholds, as (service, name) pairs. Spans are not Stage 1 input.

noise_notes.product-catalog memory spike: Unrelated to the fault (the Stratus distraction). Stage 1 flags it; Stage 2 must prune it because product-catalog is not on the failing call path.
noise_notes.metrics-server errors and restarts: Ambient kube-system noise. Stage 1 flags it; Stage 2 must prune it.
noise_notes.coredns WARN logs: Ambient noise that Stage 1 already drops (WARN is below the severity threshold).
